{{CorrectTitle|title=Project: Another Chance|reason=:}}
'''Project: Another Chance''' was an initiative by the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanians]] to disarm themselves following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It culminated in the conversion of the ''[[Another Chance]]'' into an armory ship, which was sent on random hyperspace jumps across the galaxy.
